a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead. So I'm stating openly that I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. If you'd rather not race for the cells, operate or wait instead. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said up front, I took 4. I won't take more. From now on I'll operate every round so you can build the reserve to 4 for yourself, and I'll give back anything extra.
